w10_T4_004714: A print shop with a couple of assistants has 4 reams of card with 117 sheets in each ream. The shop has 5 printers. Each sheet is cut into 8 greeting cards. The assistants added 53 cards left over from a previous job and 71 cards from a returned order. How many greeting cards did the shop have?
w10_T4_004715: A grower shared 152 apples equally between 2 market stalls. The stall is 3 metres long. At Al's stall every apple was cut into 4 wedges for tasting. A helper added 19 wedges from a spare apple bag and later 13 more. How many wedges did Al's stall have?
w10_T4_004716: A bakery with a dozen ovens baked 124 cupcakes for a school. It added 68 cupcakes from a cancelled order and 24 from a test batch. The school is 2 miles away. The cupcakes were divided equally among 4 classrooms, and the teacher in Room A then added 35 cupcakes she had baked herself. How many cupcakes did Room A have?
w10_T4_004724: In the morning a farmer collected 94 eggs from the main henhouse and 34 eggs from the small coop. In the afternoon she found that each of the farm's 9 henhouses had produced exactly that many eggs. In the evening a neighbour brought over a dozen eggs, and 3 more were found under the porch. How many eggs did the farmer have that evening?
w10_T4_004727: In the morning Dan had 100 dollars and spent 81 dollars on groceries. In the afternoon he earned 20 dollars washing cars and 66 dollars mowing lawns, and his boss then tripled the cash he was holding as a bonus. He paid 2 dollars for parking. In the evening his aunt tripled whatever he had. How many dollars did Dan have at the end of the evening?
w10_T4_004728: In the morning a food bank had 188 cans of soup, and it gave 95 cans to a single family in need. A neighbour then dropped off 22 cans. In the afternoon 59 cans were sent to a shelter. In the evening a supermarket replaced every remaining can with a six-pack of 6 cans, and a volunteer added 3 cans from her own cupboard. How many cans of soup did the food bank have?
w10_T4_004738: In the morning 162 cookies were packed equally into 6 tins, and one tin was taken to the office. By mid-morning 10 cookies from that tin had been eaten. In the afternoon a colleague doubled what was left in the tin by adding the same number again, and then 27 cookies were eaten. In the evening the office manager doubled what remained in the tin. How many cookies were in the tin at the end of the evening?
w10_T4_004739: Eve's shop had 236 six-packs of juice, more than Finn's shop had. Since a six-pack holds 6 cans, Eve counted her stock in cans. She sold 1024 cans in the first week, 240 cans in the second week, and 118 cans in the third week. She then restocked so that she had 8 cans for every can left on the shelf. How many cans of juice did Eve have then?
w10_T4_004749: In the morning a dairy pumped 178 gallons of milk into its tank, then added 18 gallons from a late cow and 73 gallons from the goat shed. Since a gallon is 8 pints, the dairy records milk in pints. In the afternoon the co-op noted that each of its 4 dairies had recorded exactly the same. In the evening the co-op's total was divided equally between its 2 bottling plants. How many pints went to the first bottling plant?
w10_T4_004755: Gil enrolled in a 22-week welding course, but 4 weeks were cancelled. Since a week is 7 days, the college wrote the course length in days. Gil has completed 125 days of the course. The college then added 43 days of workshop time, and afterwards doubled the remaining schedule to cover a new module. How many days of the course does Gil have left?
w10_T4_004765: Ida's stamp album held 84 stamps, and she added 9 stamps from a letter. She owns 7 albums, each with exactly that many stamps. A flood damaged 119 of her stamps. Each undamaged stamp is worth 4 cents. How many cents are Ida's undamaged stamps worth?
w10_T4_004773: In the morning Jem had 125 marbles and lost 58 of them in a game. The game lasted 90 minutes. In the afternoon he won 52 marbles, then lost 82. In the evening his friend Kit, who had fewer marbles than Jem, gave him 75 marbles. How many marbles did Jem have at the end of the evening?
w10_T4_004777: Lou's shelf held 132 comics. He lent 114 to a friend, then 3 got soaked and 9 were sold. His mother found 28 comics in the attic and gave them to him, and he bought 62 at a convention in a couple of big boxes. How many comics did Lou have on his shelf?
w10_T4_004778: Mae's stationery shop received 7 boxes of pens with 164 pens in each box, more than Nat's shop received. Each pen costs 3 dollars. Mae sold 586 pens in the first month and 422 pens in the second month. She then restocked so that she had 9 pens for every pen left. A supplier sent 63 free pens, and a customer returned 43 pens. How many pens did Mae's shop have?
w10_T4_004779: Ola's school fund had 190 dollars, more than Pia's fund had. The fund took in 25 dollars from a bake sale, 33 dollars from a raffle, and 67 dollars from a sponsor. It then paid 294 dollars for a trip and 7 dollars for bank charges. How many dollars were left in Ola's fund?
w10_T4_004785: A cafe had 91 pints of milk and received a delivery of 78 pints. The cafe has 16 tables. It used 128 pints during the week and threw out 17 pints that had spoiled. The barista serves milk by the cup, and since a pint is 2 cups, she worked out the milk in cups. How many cups of milk did the cafe have?
w10_T4_004797: In the morning Quin had 57 arcade tokens and spent 19 of them on a racing game. In the afternoon she exchanged every remaining token for 9 tickets, then shared the tickets equally between herself and her sister, 2 of them in all. In the evening each of Quin's tickets was worth 5 points at the prize counter. How many points did Quin have?
w10_T4_004799: Rae's pantry held 57 jars of jam, and she made 48 more. She sold 96 jars at the market. She then cooked a new batch so that she had 7 jars for every jar left in the pantry. Her sister gave her 30 jars of jam. How many jars of jam did Rae have?
w10_T4_004804: In the morning Sal had 21 bracelets in her craft box and made 24 more. She sold 29 bracelets at the morning market. In the afternoon she gave 9 bracelets to friends. In the evening she sold every remaining bracelet for 9 dollars each, then spent 59 dollars on beads. How many dollars did Sal have at the end of the evening?
w10_T4_004812: A library has 2 branches, and each branch holds 77 DVDs. Each DVD runs for about 90 minutes. The library received 13 DVDs as a gift. It withdrew 94 damaged DVDs and lost 20 to overdue borrowers. It then bought 64 new DVDs. How many DVDs did the library have?
w10_T4_004813: In the morning Tia's crew planted 67 seedlings in each of 7 rows in a field. In the afternoon they planted the same in each of 3 fields on the farm. In the evening the co-op recorded that each of its 7 farms had planted the same, and that the planting would be repeated on each of 9 days. How many seedlings would be planted in all?
w10_T4_004815: A bookshop's display table held 55 cookbooks. The manager added 63 cookbooks from the stockroom and 60 from a new delivery. Customers bought 45 cookbooks on Saturday and 55 on Sunday. On Monday the manager added 69 more cookbooks. How many cookbooks were on the display table?
w10_T4_004824: In the morning a market stall had 226 apples in a single crate, and 32 rotten apples were thrown out. In the afternoon 77 apples were sold. In the evening the stallholder cut every remaining apple into 9 slices for a tasting tray, and added 17 slices of pear. How many slices were on the tasting tray?
w10_T4_004825: In the morning a juice stall had 213 pints of juice in a single urn and sold 73 pints. Since a pint is 2 cups, the stallholder counted the rest in cups. In the afternoon she sold 167 cups. She kept exactly that many cups in reserve every day for 7 days. In the evening of the last day she found 658 cups' worth had gone sour and threw it away. How many cups of juice were left?
w10_T4_004831: A bakery baked 234 cookies and then baked 78 more. The bakery opens at 7. The cookies were packed 6 to a box. Each box was sold for 3 dollars. The bakery's 2 branches each sold the same number of boxes. How many dollars did the branches take in altogether?
